plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 61.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. None of the fixed courses on this map carry an official course prerequisite in their published descriptions (all listed as Advisories); prereq arrays are intentionally empty — see the official catalog's course descriptions. Dagger (†): some GE choice classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values. Choice slots model the official 'Select one' requirements; see choice notes.

courses.title: Survey of Art from Prehistory to the Medieval Era
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTH C1100 / ARTH C1100H per the official map's Cal-GETC 3 slot (marked M: also meets a major requirement). ARTH C1100 - Survey of Art from Prehistory to the Medieval Era; ARTH C1100H - Survey of Western Art from Prehistory to the Medieval Era Honors.

courses.title: UC/CSU Elective
courses.choice_note: Select a course that transfers to UC; see a counselor.

courses.title: Major Elective (Studio Art)
courses.choice_note: Select one of ART 120 / ART 121 / ART 135 / ART 140 / ART 230 / PHTO 130 per the official map (marked M). The map notes ART 120 is recommended. ART 120 - Two-Dimensional Design; ART 121 - Three-Dimensional Design; ART 135 - Beginning Painting; ART 140 - Ceramics I; ART 230 - Beginning Life Drawing (official prerequisite: ART 130); PHTO 130 - Beginning Photography.

courses.title: Survey of Art from the Renaissance to Contemporary
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTH C1200 / ARTH C1200H per the official map's Cal-GETC 3A slot (marked M: also meets a major requirement). ARTH C1200 - Survey of Art from the Renaissance to Contemporary; ARTH C1200H - Survey of Art from the Renaissance to Contemporary Honors.

courses.title: Survey of Mathematics
courses.choice_note: MATH 150 - Survey of Mathematics per the official map's Cal-GETC 2 row. The map's notes allow any of: DSCI 101, MATH 160, MATH 170, MATH 180, MATH 190/H, PSY 190, STAT C1000/H.

courses.title: Cal-GETC 1C - Oral Communication
courses.choice_note: Select one of COMM C1000 / COMM C1000H per the official map's Cal-GETC 1C (Oral Communication) row (codes only on the map). The map notes: take an elective class if planning to go to a UC.

courses.title: Art of the Ancient Americas
courses.choice_note: Select one of ART 104 / ART 107 / ART 108 per the official map's Cal-GETC 3B slot (marked M: also meets a major requirement). ART 104 - Art of the Ancient Americas; ART 107 - The Art of Asia; ART 108 - The Art of Mexico.

courses.title: American Government and Politics
courses.choice_note: Select one of POLS C1000 / POLS C1000H per the official map's Cal-GETC 4 row. POLS C1000 - American Government and Politics; POLS C1000H - American Government and Politics Honors (advisory: ENGL C1000).

courses.choice_note: Choose one course per the official map's Cal-GETC 1B (Critical Thinking and Composition) row: ENGL C1001, 1001H / PHIL 110, 110H (codes only on the map).
